scope: One existing narwhal record, strictly reversible; 336 other records unchanged

before.name: Head, jawline and external landmarks
before.description: An Arctic odontocete with a rounded head, no dorsal fin and mottled adult skin. This selected adult male has one elongated left upper tooth; females, juveniles and rare exceptional tusk states differ. Selected external reconstructions are not measured internal anatomy. New selected external lip/jaw opening and inner oral surfaces are shown in the feeding study; internal tissue unions and physiology remain unresolved.

before.name: Horizontal flukes and caudal peduncle
before.description: Selected horizontal flukes articulate dorsoventrally with the posterior body. Planform, excursion, tissue limits and optical response are authored and unmeasured; no computed thrust or hydrodynamic validation.

before.name: Dorsal exterior and species-specific appendages
before.description: Selected fin, ridge or finless dorsal region follows this species account. Flipper proportions and visible marks are selected external comparisons, not universal diagnostics or fitted specimen dimensions.

before.name: Selected anatomical-left erupted tusk
before.description: One usual left erupted tusk is retained from the artist, with the original spiral surface and a closed tip repair. Not a universal sex character, measured helix, socket or buried-tooth reconstruction.

after.name: Rounded head and small lateral eye
after.description: Retained rounded source head and subterminal closed mouth. Adult pigment is darker on the head and back; individual age and pattern are selected. No oversized beluga-style forehead is added.

after.name: Horizontal flukes and caudal peduncle
after.description: Source horizontal flukes move dorsoventrally with the posterior body; lateral span and source UVs stay fixed. Excursions and tissue limits are authored, without a thrust calculation.

after.name: Finless dorsal ridge and mottled skin
after.description: The source back has a low ridge and no dorsal fin. A selected adult pattern concentrates dark mottling dorsally and leaves the belly paler. Material roughness and highlights are artistic settings.

after.name: Left upper tusk; rare paired eruption
after.description: Default: the anatomical left upper tooth. Rare comparison: both original tusks. They remain rigid through every study. The source spiral is retained, with a closed tip repair; sockets, buried teeth and sensory physiology are not reconstructed.

before.label: Fluke stroke study
before.description: Finite twelve-second selected posterior dorsoventral flexion on the retained artist surface. The forebody and rigid tusk stay fixed; source flippers have no separate active joint. It is not a measured full swimming cycle, force solution or fitted trajectory.
before.evidence: Primary source-supported locomotion direction; authored unfitted excursions and display timing

rendering.reason: Local exterior motion only; full trajectories, thrust, flow and energetics are unresolved.

before.label: Stroke–glide study
before.description: A finite posterior stroke sequence settles into a selected quiet exterior posture at six illustrative seconds and holds to the endpoint. The same body, UV and pigment are retained; no root translation, buoyancy or full swimming solver.
before.evidence: Source-scoped qualitative exterior/posture comparison; selected unfitted amplitude, phase and display timing
before.timeScale: 12 uncalibrated authored seconds; not a natural behavior duration

rendering.reason: Finite local exterior study; no fitted full-body trajectory, force/flow/contact, prey transport or physiology.

before.evidence: Source-scoped qualitative exterior/posture comparison; selected unfitted amplitude, phase and display timing
before.timeScale: 12 uncalibrated authored seconds; not a natural behavior duration
